name: USA
hook: From the Manhattan skyline to the rim of the Grand Canyon
description: New York's energy, a night on the Las Vegas Strip, and the sheer scale of the Grand Canyon at sunrise — the classic first look at America, coast to desert.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~10–14hr via one connection, usually through Europe
quickFacts.climate: Varies widely — temperate in New York, desert-dry across the Southwest
